controls.case: new child window cannot restart a frozen parent route
v2 research window requires an explicit parent route
fresh child cannot renew the expired route deadline
two durable units share one cutoff and third unit is denied
canonical window identity preserves resume across a symlink alias
parent cutoff stops a running child without rewriting its own deadline
route lock excludes simultaneous commands from different child windows
ordinary work window cannot masquerade as a route ledger
missing route ledger fails before command launch
route-duration cannot exceed the existing 120 or 60 minute limit
unit-duration cannot exceed the existing 120 or 60 minute limit

scope: Command route ledger only; cannot prevent bypassing the guard or editing ledger files.
